summary: The election overhang is gone, but Iran rejected the latest US Hormuz reply while mediators push a narrower interim deal, so oil (Brent ~97 after -16% in 5 days) stays headline-driven. AI/data-center policy risk after the Texas result is compounding weak chip guidance. Futures price an 88% chance of a Dec 9 hike, and the BoE just hiked.

risks.title: US-Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz closure
risks.status: Iran's security chief Rezaei called the US reply on Hormuz 'not convincing' (Nov 3); Qatari and Pakistani mediators are working on a narrower interim deal (Iran halts shipping attacks, US lifts the port blockade), responses expected within ~36 hours (Reuters, Nov 4); the IRGC reported tankers and a tug on fire after hitting mines (Nov 5, unverified); Vance and Witkoff favor a deal, Trump 'in no rush' on strikes
risks.odds: US-Iran ceasefire holds to Dec 31: 25% (Polymarket via ScanX, early Nov)
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.market_pricing: Nov 5 07:50: Brent 96.88 (+2.4%, -15.7% over 5 days), WTI 89.51 (+1.6%); XLE -6.4pp vs SPY on Nov 4; OVX 61.7 (92nd percentile); gold 4,129 (+1.4%)
risks.impact: A signed interim deal would push Brent toward the low 90s/80s and help consumers, transports and rate-sensitive stocks while hurting energy and defense; a collapse or renewed strikes would send Brent back above $110

risks.title: Fed hiking path and Fed leadership (Chair Warsh)
risks.status: Held 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28 (10-2; Hammack and Cook dissented for a hike); ADP +86k on Nov 4 beat ~67-75k; JOLTS 7.52M beat; ISM services 54.5 (prices 73.0) Nov 4; Bank of England hiked 25bp Nov 5 (first hike in 3+ years); claims, Q3 ULC, Hammack and Barkin Nov 5; payrolls Nov 6
risks.odds: Dec 9 hike 88% (fed funds futures, Nov 5); 75% (Polymarket via rg.org, Nov 4)
risks.impact: Hot ISM prices or payrolls would cement a December hike and pressure long-duration tech; soft data would extend the rebound

risks.title: AI / data-center backlash after the midterms
risks.status: Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa (D) pledged a data-center construction moratorium; Texas holds ~27% of US data-center power capacity (Wells Fargo); Goldman says Democratic state and local wins could bring short-term moratoria affecting ~45% of planned US capacity; CoreWeave about -10% on Nov 4; Nov 5 pre-market Qualcomm about -9% and Arm about -4% on guidance, SK Hynix and Samsung slid; Macquarie sees stricter Texas AI-infrastructure rules
risks.market_pricing: Nov 4: SMH -1.5pp vs SPY, utilities -2.8pp vs SPY; Nasdaq-100 futures fell as much as 2.4% overnight before recovering
risks.impact: Moratoria in large states would slow AI-capex growth and hit chips, data-center REITs and power names; if it stays rhetoric or capacity moves to other states, the selloff is a buying opportunity for the AI theme

risks.title: US midterm elections: divided government
risks.status: Resolved Nov 3-4: Democrats won both the House and Senate (AP projections); Trump said he will accept the results and work with Democrats; the new Congress sits in January, with a lame-duck session before then
risks.odds: Resolved (pre-vote: Democrats Senate 73% prediction markets, Yahoo Finance Nov 3)
risks.market_pricing: Nov 4: Dow ~+2%, S&P +1.1%; solar +5-9%, homebuilders +6.4%, defense lower; VIX -14% to 17.9
risks.impact: Gridlock limits new fiscal policy (usually read as neutral to positive); oversight of tariffs, defense and AI spending rises; the risk is now in specific sectors rather than the index

risks.title: US government funding / shutdown risk
risks.status: The stopgap enacted Sep 2 funds the government through Dec 11; 12 full-year bills remain, to be fought in a lame-duck session before the new Democratic Congress takes over
risks.impact: A December lapse would delay economic data and dent Q4 growth (last year's shutdown lasted 43 days); a full-year deal or a clean CR into the new Congress removes it

risks.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping
risks.status: Yahoo Finance cited an overnight attack on a Saudi refinery as a driver of oil's Oct 28 rise (details unconfirmed); drones aimed at Riyadh were downed Oct 26; no newer attack found
risks.market_pricing: Oil falling on Iran diplomacy; no visible Red Sea premium shift
risks.impact: A hit on Saudi export infrastructure (Yanbu, the Red Sea alternative to Hormuz) would be a major oil shock; calm lets the Iran-deal discount continue

risks.title: OPEC+ output policy
risks.status: Nov 1: OPEC+ kept output targets unchanged through December; next meeting Nov 29; Goldman raised its December Brent forecast to $105 (2027 average $88)
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.impact: A surprise increase would be bearish for oil and energy stocks; continued restraint keeps a floor under oil if an Iran deal reopens supply

risks.title: Israel election: hung Knesset
risks.status: Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot has 61 seats (Eisenkot camp 48); Eisenkot rules out serving under Netanyahu; Herzog says he will do everything to avoid a new election, including backing a unity government; the first mandate is expected around Nov 11 (unconfirmed)
risks.impact: Prolonged talks or a new election add uncertainty to Gaza/Iran policy (a caretaker Netanyahu government is reportedly keen on strikes); a unity government would likely be more cautious

risks.title: Russia-Ukraine war and peace talks
risks.status: Trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia technical talks planned in Abu Dhabi around Nov 10; local truce in one town since Oct 27
risks.odds: Peace talks by Dec 31 90%, ceasefire by Dec 31 9.5%, by Mar 31 2027 23.5% (Polymarket via Rio Times, early Nov)
risks.market_pricing: No visible premium shift; defense fell on Nov 4 on US politics, not Ukraine
risks.impact: Real progress would be mildly bearish for defense and European gas; a collapse keeps the defense theme supported

risks.title: China-Taiwan tensions and chip export controls / tariffs
risks.status: Chinese live-fire drills across multiple seas in mid-October (not an encirclement of Taiwan); a report says US tariffs on Chinese chips are delayed to June 2027 (unconfirmed date); no new action found this week
risks.market_pricing: SMH -16pp vs SPY over 1 month, mostly AI-capex driven; Nikkei -1.4% on Nov 4
risks.impact: New export curbs or a Taiwan blockade drill would hit semis first; a trade thaw would help

risks.title: Bank of Japan decision and yen
risks.status: Oct 30: BoJ held at 1.25%, raised its inflation forecast and said it is ready to hike if needed; drop from the register after Nov 6
risks.impact: A surprise hike at a later meeting could unwind yen carry trades and pressure high-valuation tech
